verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no first-party documentation on AI-agent-specific identity patterns (cross-app access for agents, token vaulting, scoped agent credentials, Agent ID). The only proximate item is a critical community comment noting Entra 'Actor tokens' are not subject to Conditional Access and 'invite misuse,' which is a criticism rather than documented guidance, and there is no vendor claim in this pack to contrast it against. Missing for 10: any first-party docs on agent identity, cross-app access for agents, token vaulting, or scoped agent credentials.
